The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 52c828f91521d93c), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 8. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let H be a finite-dimensional vector space over a field of characteristic zero, with finite, exhaustive, separated increasing integer-indexed filtrations F• and G•. Suppose that e, f ∈ End(H) satisfy, for A• = F• and A• = G•, e(Ak) ⊆ Ak+2, f(Ak) ⊆ Ak−2. Assume that the induced raiser on each associated graded is Lefschetz with the same center r, and that [[f, e], e] = −2e, [u, v] = uv − vu. (2.6) Then Fk = Gk for every integer k. If H has a further grading respected by both filtrations, and e, f have degrees 2, −2 for that grading, the equality holds degree by degree.
